description: This class, MidiFramer, processes a stream of MIDI bytes, parsing incoming data and converting it into discrete MIDI messages, handling running status, system exclusive messages, and interleaved real-time messages. It extends android.media.midi.MidiReceiver, overriding the onSend method to perform the parsing and forwarding of MIDI messages.

classes.name: MidiFramer
classes.description: A class that converts a stream of MIDI bytes into individual MIDI messages for processing, managing MIDI protocol specifics such as running status and SysEx messages.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Overrides MidiReceiver's onSend method to parse incoming MIDI byte array, handle message framing, and pass complete messages to the designated receiver.
